label: Yak butter
note: Churned from soured milk, not from separated cream; keeps up to a year away from air. Fat of butter tea and butter lamps

about.text: Yak butter is butter made from the milk of the female yak, a staple of Tibet, the Himalaya and Mongolia: eaten with roasted barley flour, churned into butter tea, burned in lamps and modelled into festival sculptures.

how.text: As with Makhan the whole soured milk, not separated cream, goes into the churn; the leftover buttermilk is boiled into a soft cheese (chura loenpa, soft chhurpi).
